dct_description_sm: The purpose of this dataset was to determine the flow rates of the Devon Ice Cap, Nunavut, Canada during the International Polar Year (2007-2008) and compare the glacier velocities determined with those of previous studies in order to determine whether glacier velocities had changed significantly from the mid-1990s. This dataset was also combined with measured and modelled ice thicknesses at the termini of outlet glaciers in order to determine how much ice was lost via discharge to the ocean (i.e. iceberg production).
dct_title_s: Devon ice cap glacier velocity map
